date_note: Date is the day of the Debian announcement email; the advisory body is dated 25 November.
title: Debian issues runc update DSA-6656-1 for three flaws that could expose host resources or allow container escape
summary: Debian published security advisory DSA-6656-1 for runc, covering CVE-2025-31133, CVE-2025-52565 and CVE-2026-41579. The advisory says, depending on the configuration, exploitation could expose host resources, cause a denial of service, or permit container escape. For Debian stable (trixie) it says the problems are fixed in version 1.1.15+ds1-2+deb13u1 and recommends upgrading runc packages.
plain: Debian released a runc update fixing three flaws that, per its advisory, could expose host resources, cause denial of service or allow escape from a container.
exec: Debian says the runc flaws could permit container escape, so Debian-based container hosts need the update.
action: Debian recommends upgrading runc packages; on Debian stable (trixie) the fixed version is 1.1.15+ds1-2+deb13u1.

evidence.quote: We recommend that you upgrade your runc packages.
For the stable distribution (trixie), these problems have been fixed in version 1.1.15+ds1-2+deb13u1.

validation.note: Debian's own security announcement read; LinuxSecurity relays it.
